title: Made anything cool with Fable 5 already?
author: Low-Cook-3544
selftext: My entry for the Fable 5 hype

comments.author: Afraid-Yoghurt6731
comments.body: try making a planet generator with launch and re-entry - Elite 2 had it in early 90ies.

replies.author: Low-Cook-3544
replies.body: 100%. I've made asset editors on Fable before it was rolled back where I rigged 3D characters then ported them into my game on Rosebud. Definitely want to look at a planet generator or some advanced shared work next

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body: wow fable looks good, might make me revisit some projects if it can clean up shading this well now and lighting

replies.author: Low-Cook-3544
replies.body: This was a one shot and i was honestly impressed. I asked it to make a 3D space explorer but to focus on aesthetic looks and self-iterate until it's satisfied with dramatic visuals instead of sloppy ones. So the grain effect and stuff comes from there. There's a lot more asset and gameplay work to be done but I'm loving it.
